# MarcoMC — Marco Massari Calderone

> Software & infrastructure consultant. Application development, web development, DevOps, API integrations and automation.

Consulting enquiries and project quotes: [marco@marcomc.com](mailto:marco@marcomc.com).

Alongside consulting, I develop personal software projects. These are areas of ongoing development, not a catalogue of commercially available products.

The linked Markdown pages are generated from the same content as the public website. GitHub statistics include their snapshot date and counting method. English is the primary language; Italian, Spanish (Spain), French and Portuguese (Portugal) versions are also available.
